avoidance.model: Content-derived resizable frames; overlap projection translates groups; regenerate boundary terminals and all exterior routes for every evaluated candidate. No frame size or node movement cap. Node/link hits first, then equal baseline-relative penetration, crossings, overlap and length; displacement breaks ties. Existing display insets, boundary-terminal spacing, node dimensions and internal depth order remain. Internet node anchored; no fixed frame order or ring. Add soft node/node and group/group expanded-footprint overlap penalties. Band area is areaRatio times each painted rectangle area, outside the stroke; thickness is recomputed with frame size. Halo separation proposals are scored, not hard-projected. Each halo penalty is a separate initial-relative objective with equal weight.
